title: phlomis longifolia var. bailanica
intro: Phlomis longifolia var. bailanica, commonly known as Balkan Jerusalem sage, is a plant species within the Lamiaceae family. It is traditionally used in folk medicine to treat various health conditions, including gastrointestinal issues, due to its health benefits, which include anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties. The therapeutic actions of Phlomis longifolia var. bailanica include its ability to relax muscles, reduce anxiety, and alleviate symptoms of depression, while its bioactive constituents, such as iridoids and phenolic acids, contribute to its medicinal properties. However, more research is needed to fully understand its effects and potential applications.
